FROM DISRUPTION TO DISCUSSION

Three paths forward.
No hidden trade-offs.

What would your team prioritize? Explore a reproducible scenario and see how each recovery strategy changes the outcome.

SYNTHETIC SCENARIO / SEED 42
60 flights 6 airports 4 disruptions

Four connected constraints

  • Aircraft: T01 is released from maintenance at 20:45, 105 minutes after RX104’s scheduled departure.
  • Ground handling: a synthetic ORD message adds 45 minutes to affected turnarounds.
  • Crew: C01 has only 45 minutes beyond its original final release.
  • Positioning: T01 must reach PIT by 23:20 to protect its next rotation.

This is a model demonstration, not a live airport feed.

Same disruption. Different priorities.

Results come from the repository’s default model. Selecting a strategy inspects a saved result; it does not run or approve a plan.

BUILT AROUND A HUMAN DECISION

The reasoning belongs
in the room.

Give airport teams a concrete basis for conversations with airline and ground-handling partners. See the evidence, surface constraints, and understand what a recovery choice leaves behind.

01 / CONTEXT

Start with the operation.

Connect maintenance holds and turnaround delays to the flights, passengers, and rotations they affect.

02 / EXPLANATION

Make the math visible.

Inspect four separate measures. There’s no combined score quietly choosing a winner for you.

03 / JUDGMENT

Keep people in control.

Modeled crew constraints block infeasible choices. The full simulator requires explicit human approval.

What this prototype models—and its current limits +

FlowBetter is a synthetic airline recovery prototype presented for airport operations discussions. It compares three fixed strategies; it is not a live airport coordination platform, gate-management system, or global optimization engine.

Passenger points combine passenger delay minutes and missed connections. Network penalty measures missed overnight positions. Crew checks use simplified duty rules and do not establish regulatory compliance. No real airline or airport actions are exposed.
